Name: Personal Sunroom (PIF)
Author: omena007
Description:
Adds your very own sunroom to the farm house with the magic of DeLiXx's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF.[/url]﻿ You can either buy the Sunroom Door from Robin after seeing Caroline's Sunroom or use any other door available in the game. The door can be placed on any wall of the house so it doesn't cause compatibility issues.

The room has a water source and the randomized butterflies can be turned off from config if needed. If you want to have butterflies flying around the room you can use the butterfly hutch from the desert trader.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/7886557-1725804964.png[/img]
DeLiXx for PIF
Abagaianye, rokugin and others on stardew discord channel for helping me a lot with the map editing!

Furniture mods seen in the pictures: PlatinumCats' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27047]Rattan Furniture[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24980?tab=description]Modular Garden Planters[/url] by Birbeton
